notes.title: January 5th Update - Queen Beast Build 1.22
notes.notes:
**Update: apparently save files were breaking, so I have reverted to the previous until I can resolve the issue with older save files >_< really sorry!!!**

Hello everyone again!
I have pushed a small patch update that addresses the following:
[list]
[*] Updates the version of Ren'Py to a more recent version; this should address the freezing issues on the Steam Deck!
[*] Updated the Audio slider code since Ren'Py now has a master volume implemented by default
[/list]
Please let me know if you continue to have any issues or bugs and feel free to ask any questions on the forums!
I have uploaded the game's OST to a playlist on youtube here: [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLhLkqqmp13fwXtTcNKj5fv-q44hMDurMb]QB OST![/url]
Thank you everyone who has played or left a review so far >u<! We really appreciate everything.

notes.title: Build Update - Queen Beast 1.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!!

I have pushed a small update to the build that adds:

[list]
[*] 'Streamer Mode' in the settings menu - completely obscures all instances of partial nudity, 'buttocks', more egregious examples of cleavage, etc. 
[*] Revamped the modesty filter code so that it should update dynamically so you don't have to reload the scene
[*] Fixed an issue with the chapter numbering
[*] Fixed some small issues with the map
[/list]
Examples of the streamer mode:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050516/a7f7f66ab8207d0289de996d2a34bf4097e261e7.png[/img]

If you encounter any other bugs, please let us know via the steam forum or email so we can get it patched up as soon as possible =].

Thanks so much for all your reviews and feedback (even people who were lukewarm on the game!), every piece is invaluable to us >_< Thank you!!!
